title: Side View of Suburban Garage, 1942 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A 1942 black-and-white snapshot showing the side view of a white stucco garage or house with a hip roof and a white door leading to a manicured lawn yard. Newly planted saplings stand staked in the foreground, with a white picket fence visible to the left. At the far right edge of the frame, two young children can be seen standing near the building.
